name: task_update
description: Update task progress. ALWAYS finish with completed/failed/cancelled to release its screen-awake hold. Operational commands and task updates renew a three-minute task activity lease; inactivity releases the display automatically. Other active tasks retain their holds.

name: command_run
description:
Execute one capability. Prefer named direct tools when provided. For an unfamiliar ID below, call capability_status(id), fill its schema, then execute; never guess arguments. The same ID/schema can be reused. Dynamic index:
guide.get: Read an operation guide; guideId=picoadb.connect: enable Wi-Fi ADB through PICO UI and reconnect saved pairing
phone.ring: Start or stop a find-phone ring
phone.lock: Lock the screen
phone.notify: Post a phone notification
audio.status: Read media, ring, alarm and notification volume
audio.set: Set one audio stream volume percentage
microphone.record: Record a short microphone clip
notification.get: Read one notification by key
notification.dismiss: Clear one notification, or batch-clear all with a saved digest
notification.actions: Read notification buttons and reply options
notification.invoke_action: Invoke a discovered notification button
clipboard.get: Read clipboard text
clipboard.set: Replace clipboard text
contacts.search: Find contacts by name
contacts.get: Read contact details by discovered id
calendar.list: Read calendar events in a time range
calendar.get: Read an event by eventId
calendar.create: Create a calendar event
calendar.update: Edit an event by eventId
calendar.delete: Delete an event by eventId
file.pick: Ask the human to select files
media.pick: Ask the human to select photos or videos
share.send: Open share sheet; human selects destination
workspace.info: Phone workspace and installed runtimes
workspace.list: List phone workspace files
workspace.read: Read a chunk of a workspace text file
workspace.write: Write or append workspace text
node.start: Start a workspace Node.js program
node.status: Read Node.js program state
node.stop: Stop the Node.js program
app.update: Install PickPico from verified APK URL and hash
app.update_check: Check for a PickPico update
app.update_latest: Install latest PickPico update
app.update_status: Read PickPico installation progress
process.run: Run a predefined diagnostic
process.exec: Run a phone shell command
process.output: Read process output using offsets
process.stop: Stop a process session

name: picoadb_status
description: Wireless Debugging and privileged access state; disconnected: guide.get(picoadb.connect) uses PICO UI to enable Wi-Fi ADB.
